nodes.title: Interoception in self-harm and suicide
nodes.summary: Across 66 studies, greater trust in bodily signals was associated with fewer suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
todo: Confirm any relationship to a named lab project.
Add any remaining authors after confirming their directory records.
nodes.featuredNote: A starting point for the lab’s work on how people sense and interpret body signals.

nodes.title: School-based suicide prevention using the gatekeeper programme
nodes.summary: In an 84-school trial, trained teachers reported greater confidence and willingness to intervene. Differences persisted at 12 months.
todo: Add any remaining authors after confirming their directory records.
nodes.featuredNote: A starting point for how the lab evaluates prevention programs in schools.

nodes.title: Brief digital intervention for adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury
nodes.summary: Text-message support reduced self-injury at four weeks in a trial of 86 adolescents. The difference was no longer statistically significant at eight weeks.
todo: Confirm any relationship to a named lab project.
Add any remaining authors after confirming their directory records.
nodes.featuredNote: A starting point for the lab’s trials of digital support.
